review.description:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Requirements

* Todd's 21 October decision: Review starts automatically when Build saves a ready-for-review result. There is no Review button or other human step.
* Todd's 21 October decision: this card replaces the saved-candidate Review card (<issue id="cc211e75-9a01-4eb7-a256-b5fce8a50db0" href="https://linear.app/julia-next/issue/JUL-233/review-the-exact-saved-candidate-once-from-the-julia-control-page">JUL-233</issue>).
* Todd's 22 October 2026 21:21 decision: only the runner starts reviews, with at most two rounds per card. The builder cannot start a review.

## Order

The Build card (<issue id="6486c5a7-1f21-4778-8c22-a76160a79952" href="https://linear.app/julia-next/issue/JUL-231/start-builds-the-saved-card-and-saves-the-result">JUL-231</issue>) comes first.
